# unbash, vendored

- Upstream: https://github.com/webpro-nl/unbash
- Release: 6.0.0, commit `968c14992a43dc06ce29c9f51858abd4a87851ea`
- License: ISC, in `LICENSE` beside this file

`scripts/vendor-unbash.ts` writes this directory from a checkout of that commit: `npm run vendor -- <checkout>`. It copies `src/parser.ts` and every file it reaches through relative imports, which is every file of upstream's `src/` except `printer.ts`, and upstream's `LICENSE`.

## Edits

Each copied file is upstream's text with two lines put before it, and nothing else changed:

1. `// Code generated by scripts/vendor-unbash.ts from unbash 6.0.0 (968c149…). DO NOT EDIT.`, so the dead-code self-check retains the copy as generated code.
2. `// @ts-nocheck`, because upstream compiles under its own strict settings, which do not enable `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `exactOptionalPropertyTypes` or `noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature`; under this repository's settings 96 of upstream's lines fail them.

The directory is left out of ESLint (`eslint.config.mjs`), of Prettier (`.prettierignore`, which leaves out the generated contract modules too) and of the mutation targets (`stryker.config.json`, which leaves out the generated `src/conformance-record.ts` too). The repository measures no coverage, so nothing is left out of it.
